main.description: Asks for a new policy for the packages in an organization's scope ('dev.zena-lang.org.policy'). The caller must be an owner of the organization. The host holds the record, outside the organization's repository, until the members record's 'ownerThreshold' of owners have attested it, and 'dev.zena-lang.host.completeChange' writes it. Its teams must exist, and its defaults must ask no less than its minimums.

organization.description: The organization, whose handle is a scope on this host.

swapRecord.description: The CID the record must have now; the write fails with 'InvalidSwap' otherwise.

uri.description: Where the new record will be written, which an attestation names.

cid.description: The new record's CID, which an attestation names.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The record's current CID is not 'swapRecord'.

errors.name: TeamNotFound
errors.description: A default team or a creator is not a team of the organization.
